categories.rationale: No verb, objective, copy or beat predicate moves. Story authority honoured in the mix: -3 dB story-lead cap measured; story floors within 0.01 LU; bare/colour identical. Every acknowledgement cue now passes a held-level law and +10.34 ms path delay — under a frame, recorded for the Stage 3 UX audit.

Effects rise from 20 dB to 9.5 dB under the bed; music steps aside 6 dB in 35 ms and returns in 0.8 s without pumping; quiet passages unchanged to 0.01 dB. But the blind hears a broadband recession ("mixed rather than orchestrated"), a 16 dB clearance that may be too much room, and the BLOOM peak is still absent (deferred, not delivered).

No image term moves. A Stage 3 image-sync hazard was found (C6 trigger stale; 14.875 ms music-vs-SFX skew) and Cinematography has drafted the amendment; until signed, anchor timing semantics are unbound.

Tail order correct and shared by live/mirror; duck matrix row-for-row within 0.0 dB; SYMPHONY LAW clean; 0 smoothness violations; no clicks introduced. Three acceptance terms unmet by architecture (BLOOM, -18 sum, writes/s), mixIntent wording wrong in two sentences, one active duck row unmeasured.

Sound-as-rendering holds through the mix: bare, colour and floors unchanged to 0.01 dB; quietest second untouched everywhere; ui/voice dry because the institution is not underwater; sandbox and menu unity by law.

Snapshot mixer pure and deterministic; dirty-checked, slewed writes; start-anchored duck envelopes. Gaps: cap resolved at schedule time only; two doors to the SFX muffle; per-flush dedupe vs stated per-frame; the sandbox-no-op probe cannot engage mining; dive stress script steps where play is continuous.

A bespoke, honest mix architecture (subtract-only tail, story-lead cap, dry REGULATION, one createMixTail) rather than a preset. Yet the mix reads as competent recession, not authored gesture — the stage's own peak ambition (BLOOM window) was not delivered here.

Lean tier not re-rendered through the new tail; audio-thread cost not re-measured at 4x for Stage 2; +10.34 ms acknowledgement delay and held-level law unaudited by a player-experience reader (skip accepted with condition).

verify 2460 green, score:fps 60.39, audio:check 13/13, every builder number reproduced bit-identically by the verifier. Writes/s term unmet (593 vs 60); ms/frame not re-measured; latency constants single-rate.

Self-incriminating deviation log, honest limiter write-up, verifier reproduction, blind report declaring its limits. Weakened by a README double-count, a stale human-decision binding, a 5 ms-bin margin claim and a Stage 3 start recorded before judgement.
